author: Lost in Time
description:
Get The Rome Poster: https://lostintime.io/collections/ancient-rome

For this video, we teamed up with Flyover Zone and Rome Reborn who has worked on this incredible Rome model since 1996. This is a complete 3D reconstruction of Rome.

We travel back to Rome in year 320 AD, and explore some of the most famous monuments like the Colosseum, the advanced technology of the Aqueduct systems, Pantheon, Circus Maximus, The Roman Forum (Forum Romanum) and the beautiful Baths of Caracalla.
